method: per-criterion median across three judges, then weighted by the rubric

notes.problem: A flat unlit lamp disc and flat rotor ellipses.
notes.fix: An emissive lens in a housing with bloom and a cool cone, blurred blades.

notes.problem: The showstopper's accent is a flat unshaded disc pasted over the drone; flat rotor ellipses.
notes.fix: A recessed emissive lens in a dark housing with bloom and spill, motion-blurred blades or a tighter crop.

notes.problem: Flat unlit lamp disc and flat rotor ellipses, named by all three judges in round 2.
notes.fix: An emissive lens in a housing with bloom and a cool cone on the nearest cattle, motion-blurred blades.

notes.problem: An oversized cylinder trap beside a centred mannequin.
notes.fix: A true-size modelled trap in the near foreground as the lit focal, the worker a backlit silhouette.

notes.problem: A flat-lit mannequin from behind and a bare cylinder trap.
notes.fix: Turn the worker toward the key, cut at the knees, and model a ribbed bucket trap with a rim light.

notes.problem: A centred kit mannequin beside an oversized trap.
notes.fix: The trap at true size in the near foreground as the lit focal, the worker a backlit silhouette.

notes.problem: Grey stone, bedding lines across the cuts, terraced walls, dead lower third.
notes.fix: Mask the bedding in the cuts and narrow the band so the stone outside goes near black.

notes.problem: Smeared cut walls, uniform noise stone, bedding lines through the numerals, dead lower third.
notes.fix: Regenerate the wall texture, lower the noise outside the band, mask the bedding from the cuts, extend the dressed lower edge.

notes.problem: Grey-middle stone with bedding lines across the cut floors.
notes.fix: Darken the stone outside a narrow band and mask the bedding inside the cuts.

notes.problem: A full-length kit rancher and toy Hereford on flat mid-brown loam; the hand on the chain is not lit.
notes.fix: Reframe over the rancher's shoulder at the latch with the hand and chain lit in a tight pool.

notes.problem: A full-length kit rancher and a toy Hereford on flat mid-brown loam.
notes.fix: Reframe over the rancher's shoulder at the latch and let the loam beyond fall to black.

notes.problem: Flat navy slats and pickup under a wide mid-tone sky.
notes.fix: Brushed aluminium slats with a warm rim, a white pickup in shadow, the seam pulled down.

notes.problem: Flat navy slats with no metal response and a mid-tone caliche plain.
notes.fix: Brushed aluminium with a seam streak and lower-panel dust; let the left road fall to near black.

notes.problem: Sky banding and a thin windmill.
notes.fix: Blue-noise dither before the grade and a closer camera.

notes.problem: Sky banding and a grey-brown middle band with a thin windmill.
notes.fix: Dither the sky and move the camera closer so the wheel and tank own the right half.

notes.problem: Overlapping lattices into a moire thicket, footings outside any pool, a hard ground-plane edge.
notes.fix: Raise the camera, widen the rows, thin the rear lattice, pool the front footings and fog the plane edge.

notes.problem: Front towers tangle through the back-row wheels.
notes.fix: Raise the eye, double the row spacing and reduce back rows to wheel silhouettes.

rounds_source: this module's own log of cards it has scored
